note: Advisories in the Expo SDK 57 toolchain with no fixed release, or whose fix breaks the dependant. Each entry blocks again after reviewBy. Owner approval is required before merging.

advisories.reason: No fixed release exists (3.0.3 is the latest). Reached through micromatch in Metro, Jest and the Expo CLI on developer and CI machines; patterns come from project config, not app users.
No fixed release exists (1.1.3 is the latest). Reached through argparse/js-yaml in build tooling; format strings are not user input.
No fixed release exists (1.4.0 is the latest). Used by @expo/code-signing-certificates in the Expo CLI for optional update code signing, which this project does not enable; not bundled into the app.

The fixed 0.5.0 is ESM-only and breaks query-string 7, which expo-router 57 requires. Runs on the device for in-app URLs; a malformed link can only slow the user's own app. Revisit when expo-router moves off query-string 7.
